name: personal-speech
description:
Writes personal speeches for occasions including weddings, eulogies, toasts, graduations, retirements, and celebrations with opening hooks, personal anecdotes, and emotional resonance.
Use when the user asks to write a speech for a personal occasion, toast, eulogy, wedding speech, graduation address, or tribute.
Do NOT use for professional presentations (use business skills), political speeches (different conventions), or persuasive arguments (use academic-argument).
